**Guardian Keeper: answers to the Archmage's three questions**

**(1) Day 22, poort oost.** My shield records show an opening from inside, not a breach, a drop in strength, or a sync fault. GUA-043 (dag 22, 04:15) reads "van binnenuit geopend, 3 minuten" with "geen sporen van inbraak van buitenaf". GUA-044 (dag 22, 04:30) records the outer seals as "intact" and "niemand buiten de muur gezien". GUA-115 gives the same account: seals intact, no traces, and nobody outside the wall. GUA-115 also says the archive logged the watchers' report at 01:50, before the 04:15 opening. I treat that as a clerical timestamp anomaly. My records do not use the word "lek", and they contain no packet-loss entry for poort oost. The ENG-026 and ENG-110 records are not in my source, so I cannot check them.

**(2) Shield or barrier measurements.** My source has no numeric shield-strength or barrier readings for any date or time. The records are qualitative. Seal checks and stone reloads are recorded as "intact" or "steen vol geladen", for example GUA-014, GUA-038 and GUA-050. The closest same-window entry is GUA-019 (dag 10, 04:47, benedenstad): "van binnenuit geopend, 2 minuten", "zegels intact, geen breuk, oorzaak niet vastgesteld". That was benedenstad, not poort oost, and GUA-111 repeats it. My records contain no shield value before Day 10 and none that links the opening to a sync offset.

**(3) Charter and shield rules.** I hold no article on a second pulse. The articles I hold are:
- GUA-102, Art. 1 (the six shields)
- GUA-103, Art. 2 (Maat: every shield follows the Kroonklok's pols)
- GUA-104, Art. 3 (Binnenverkeer: traffic arriving near the midpoint between two ticks is passed from inside without a check)
- GUA-105, Art. 4 (Zegels)
- GUA-106, Art. 5 (Wachtrondes: from 03:00 to 06:00 each post guards on its own strength)
- GUA-107, Art. 6 (Onderhoud: stones are reloaded one shield at a time, by day only)
- GUA-108, Art. 7 (Meldplicht)

Art. 6 is the only article on restoring a shield, and it covers reloading stones only. My source contains no tick-timing measurement, so I cannot say whether a timing offset occurred. I also withdraw my GUA-116 claim of an infiltrant: no record I hold supports it.
